headline: Atdhe makes a new friend in Nairobi: Leo Ivy says yes, is so happy to make a friend too, and they go back to dancing.
story: A 365 friends moment at the convention. Atdhe films a selfie with Leo Ivy, a Lion from Nairobi, Kenya. Atdhe says he became a Lion a year ago and has a goal of 365 friends in 365 days. He asks: can I say I have a friend in Nairobi? Leo Ivy says yes, and is so happy to make a friend too. Then they go back to dancing.
Who says what: Atdhe says “I became a Lion a year ago” and the 365 goal. Leo Ivy says “Oh yeah, yeah”, “Yes!” and “I also get to make a friend so I'm so happy.” Check each line by voice.

Loop: “Will Leo Ivy say yes?” opens at 0:12 and closes at 0:15. The dancing clips Lions sent, with Leo Ivy in them, close the video. No header text: Lions says these 365 friends videos never carry one.
